description: V1.7 performance budget. Compares the HEAD candidate against the V1.6.0 baseline on the same machine/JDK/JVM args. A regression is the candidate metric being HIGHER (worse) than the baseline. The runner reads this file and never rewrites or relaxes it; threshold changes require documented review. The initial 20% median/P95 budget applies only to KEY hit/miss paths (gated=true); the four observation-only scenarios (no-agent-baseline, agent-loaded-not-enhanced, inventory-query, event-buffer-full-drop) are mandatory and schema-validated but NOT budget-gated, because their absolute timings are inherently noisy or non-dispatch-dominated.
